title: Card 1: App aur DB ke beech Redis. Click pe pehle Redis dekho, wahan nahi to DB se laao, Redis me rakh do

boxes.title: DB (sach yahin)
lines: Redis khoya to yahin se dobara

callouts.red: DB ki copy (replica) ya Memcached laga dete?
callouts.green: Copy bhi disk se padhti, to dheemi hi rehti. Memcached ki apni copy nahi hoti, gira to saari bheed seedha DB pe
Jo link sabse der se nahi khula, use nikaal do (LRU). Arpan ka garam link andar hi rehta
Uski copy turant kaam sambhal leti. Copy bhi gayi to 1000 click me se sirf ek DB tak jaata, baaki uska jawab ruk ke le lete

callouts.red: Arpan ne link badla, par Redis me purana pada tha
callouts.green: Pehle DB me naya likho, phir Redis se purana hata do. Agla click DB se naya laata

callouts.red: Bot ne nakli code (/xyz999) pe lakhon click bheje
callouts.green: Itna bada number abhi tak diya hi nahi gaya, to App wahin 404 bol deta. DB tak koi nahi jaata

callouts.red: Har App apna alag cache rakh le?
callouts.green: Arpan ne link badla to har App ke paas purani copy reh jaati. Isliye sabka ek hi Redis

callouts.red: Ek link viral hua to DB ki wo machine garam ho jaayegi? Nahi, wo link pehle hi Redis me mil jaata.
callouts.green: Delete ya expire hua link: Redis me "ye link nahi hai" 1 min ke liye likh do, taaki DB se baar-baar na poocha jaaye

kyun: Redis RAM me hai, ~0.1 ms me jawab deta. DB disk pe, ~10 ms. 100 me se 95 click Redis se hi nikal jaate, DB aaram se rehta. Asli data DB me hi hai, Redis sirf jaldi wali copy, kho bhi jaaye to DB se dobara ban jaati
peeche: shuru: ek App, ek DB, har click DB tak
ab: Arpan ka sale wala link viral hua, har click DB tak gaya, DB baith gaya
agla: ab App hi ek machine hai. Wo giri to? (card 2)
